name: Smart Lighting for Hue & Govee
headline: Your Hue + Govee lights. One Stream Deck.
description:
Control Philips Hue and compatible Govee lights from one Stream Deck. Skip the app switching and keep your everyday lighting controls on the keys.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Toggle individual lights and supported Hue rooms or zones with live power feedback.
• Set brightness, color and color-temperature presets, and recall supported scenes.
• Switch power for eligible mixed-brand favorites with one press.
• Adjust supported brightness on Stream Deck+ dials and view lighting status on Neo.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• Editable profiles for Standard/MK.2, XL, Stream Deck+ and Neo.
• One shared, local PackRat Lighting Companion for Hue and Govee.

QUICK SETUP
Install the Windows companion, connect Philips Hue locally and/or discover compatible Govee LAN lights, then paste its local pairing token into Stream Deck. Some Govee devices and scenes require an optional Govee Developer API key configured in the companion.

COMPATIBILITY
Windows and Stream Deck with the local companion. Available features vary by light and model. Mixed-brand favorites require reachable, power-capable lights marked as favorites. No affiliation with or endorsement by Hue or Govee.
release_notes:
• Unified Hue + Govee light power, brightness and supported color/scene controls.
• One-press mixed-brand favorites, plus live Stream Deck+ brightness dials and display-only Neo status.
• Editable MK.2, XL, Plus and Neo profiles; reuse the existing secure local PackRat Lighting Companion.
